direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; main uses independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with zero overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone to maintain viewport fit, never introduce a vertical rail
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver only: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header width with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular numerals
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; single 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left at native aspect and Lock recovery room right; opening story retains second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail built from single steps array with equal-width targets, aria-current and arrow-key roving; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene in its reserved zone; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under distinct headings, status and controls, never conflated; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form, do not infer missing functionality from pre-selection screenshots; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan coexist while replacements await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and reduce the right evidence zone width; keep callouts, stations and jobs in separate reserved zones without shrinking body type below 16px.
Raise rail, legend, station meta and source-detail labels that render under 16px to 16px body or 12px minimum micro-labels, preserving viewport fit by tightening gaps.
Make Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks plus DOES NOT MATCH fully aligned inside the scene, with bidirectional highlighting to the matching evidence cards.
Separate provider-identity connection readiness from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status lines and controls so the two are never read as one action.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and lift small route, sample-status and legend text to the 16px body minimum or 12px floor.
Add a visible 2px emerald focus ring with offset to the route select and primary, and confirm reduced-motion removes the route trace while text status remains.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main; keep the three comparison paths in the side zone without compressing finish and cost metrics below 16px.
Give each Select this path control a stronger selected state beyond the radio dot, using emerald border and fill contrast, before it opens the typed consent form.
Align the in-scene path summaries with the side-zone 83h, 35h and 17.5h tradeoffs so values match at a glance.
Keep the 3 proposed, untracked-until-approval tasks visually distinct from tracked work with dashed silver borders, and retain 0 blocked prior as a separate count.
Raise awaiting-approval, due and dependency text to 16px and remove progress bars that imply tracked progress before approval.
Balance the three station cards and three job cards inside the enlarged scene zone so task 03 no longer crowds the right edge.
Strengthen the preview state: keep CELL-MILL-2 in silver hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE preview wording, and ensure no emerald route passes through it once applied.
Raise preview, rate and scenario-management text to 16px body or 12px minimum and keep the invalidating-action status centred in the action bar.
Make the 24h to 0h capacity callout tabular and linked by bidirectional highlighting to the CELL-MILL-2 side-zone row.
Separate provider-identity connection readiness from the reinvestigation evidence task as in Step 2, with independent status and controls.
Keep stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; lift 0h replan text to 16px.
Enlarge the scene toward 70% of main and mark Split available capacity as constrained in-scene consistently with the 3 to 2 feasible paths note.
Keep the constrained Split path unavailable with silver hatching, cross marker and the two-online-cells reason at 16px, not selectable.
Raise finish and incremental placeholder labels under the constrained path so they remain legible without implying values.
Make prior-acceptance-invalidated status in the action bar match the side-zone Scenario changed notice in wording and placement.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks and 3 proposed replacements as separate groups; expand the blocked list so all three are visible within the reserved side zone at 16px.
Remove or flatten progress bars on untracked proposed tasks so awaiting approval is not read as tracked progress.
Clarify CELL-MILL-2 as OFFLINE with replan required using silver hatching and cross marker on its station card.
Enlarge the three proof stations within the scene zone and raise READY and LOCKED supporting text to 16px while keeping one primary, Verify ledger.
Condense the passphrase guidance to one instruction and one status sentence, keeping input label and help at 16px inside the side zone.
Add focus ring and aria-live status for the sequential verify, seal and retain steps so locked stages explain their prerequisite in text.
Refit the board header context so the stage title matches the Recovery project board view instead of a conflicting step label, while keeping the compact horizontal rail and header tabs unchanged.
Fill the empty In progress, Blocked and Done columns with their true zero-state text at 16px and give the single To do card balanced column height rather than a tall empty scene.
Align board counts 3 tracked, 0 done, 0 blocked with the side-zone task detail, and raise assignee, dependency and due text to 16px with a visible focus ring on the status select.
